purpose: Fail-closed handoff template for reconciling exact accepted T10/T11 public IDs after those dependencies are approved and integrated. Blank fields are intentional before activation.

resolved_public_id_shape.kind: semantic kind such as transform_state, transform_recipe, camp_state, camp_recipe_binding
resolved_public_id_shape.source_path: repository-relative JSON source containing the identifier
resolved_public_id_shape.json_pointer: RFC6901-style pointer resolving to the exact identifier value

rules: Do not populate accepted_integrated_source until the dependency has an accepted integrated completion record.
Every resolved ID must be proven by repository source_path plus exact JSON pointer; prose-only evidence is insufficient.
No provisional/prepared/example/debug/test-only identifier may be promoted as a shipping progression binding.
Resolution is read-only proof. T12 may consume accepted IDs but may not mutate T10/T11 source files or semantics.
Any missing or ambiguous required ID blocks T12 activation rather than being guessed.
